notes.title: Awards from IDA and release date announcement
notes.notes:
[p]We are happy to tell you that last month we won four awards in Indie Dev Argentina. It was super exciting for us because so many people were able to try the game, and everyone seemed to enjoy it! We're very happy that everyone is liking the game so much.[/p][p][/p][p]We also didn't expect to win four awards at the event: [/p][p]- Best Game Design[/p][p]- Excellence in Audio[/p][p]- Press Over Award[/p][p]- Best Video Game of IDA 2025 [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much to IDA, Press Over, and everyone who came to play! [/p][p]Also, this week we were interviewed about the awards by Press Over! It was the first time that the full team met in person. All of us live in Argentina except Chabbie, who is currently living in Japan. [/p][p][/p][p]Chabbie is visiting Argentina, so we took the opportunity to do an interview with our friends at Press Over. The interview was fantastic, and you can watch it on YouTube. Currently, it's only in Spanish.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="DyyIJ7VGzPo;full"][/previewyoutube][p] [/p][p]We want to take this opportunity to announce that we'll be releasing the game on Steam in November of this year, if all goes well. [/p][p]We hope you continue to enjoy the demo in the meantime and keep recommending it to your friends![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320652/9b2f849d3eaae1e8370bc6392a57e29dd878f348.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Toni Leys, Tembac and Joaco receiving the awards! 
 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320652/5de3f36d756ccd19e4a0f397f5134af893027011.jpg"][/img]From Top: Joaco, Toni Leys, Tembac, and Chabbie with the Press Over Team: Juan Lomanto, Mer Grazini, and Belu Satulovsky.[/p]
